entities.summary: Majid Abd al-Amir Adir al-Attabi, better known as Majid Al Mohandis, is an Iraqi Saudi singer and composer. His success in the Arab world has earned him the titles of "the Engineer of the Arabic song" and "Voice of Diamond".
